name: Unbanish Me
description: Your opponent's cards aren't banished by the effects of your "Runick" cards. This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Toadally Aw-Dangit
description: Negate the second effect of "Toadally Awesome". This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Partial Zombification
description: The effect of "Zombie World" instead makes your opponent's monsters also become Zombie. Negate the second effect of "Zombie World". This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Hex-Unsealed
description: If you activate the effect of a "Hex-Sealed" monster, you can use Patchwork.

name: Didn't see that coming?
description: If you would Fusion Summon using "Surprise Fusion", you can use Patchwork.

name: First is Worst
description: You cannot Summon Fusion Monsters with the effect of "The First Darklord". Negate the first effect of "The First Darklord". This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Missing Piece
description: "Frightfur Sabre-Tooth" can be destroyed by battle ignoring its effect. This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Construct Constriction
description: You can only use each effect of "El Shaddoll Construct" once per turn. This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Everlasting Burning:
description: "Ashened" monsters in your possession are always also treated as FIRE monsters. This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Cold Fire
description: Your opponent takes no damage from the effects of "Volcanic Emperor". Negate the first effect of "Volcanic Inferno". This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: A Good Offense
description: Negate the first effect of "Cosmic Slicer Zer'oll". This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Necr-NO-Valley
description: Negate the second, third, and fourth effects of "Necrovalley". This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Mythical Mishaps
description: You cannot activate the monster effect of "Mythical Beast Jackal King". This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Do you Dhea?
description: You cannot Tribute an opponent's monster to Summon "Predaplant Dheadevil". This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Dragonna Live
description: Negate the first effect of "Black Rose Dragon". You can only use the first effect of "Bramble Rose Dragon" once per turn. This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Ed… ward…?
description: Once per turn: You can Fusion Summon "Chimera the Flying Mythical Beast" by banishing 1 of the materials from your GY and Tributing the other from your hand or field. "Berfomet" is now treated as a Flip Monster.

name: Small Caves
description: The effect of "Subterror Cave Clash" to gain ATK/DEF only grants 100 ATK/DEF for each set monster on the field instead of 500. This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Going HAM
description: The Fusion materials for "Master of Ham" are 2 Flip Monsters.

name: Don’t Flip Out
description: If “Chakravartin Sphinx” would be sent from the field to the GY, banish it instead. This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Frightful Fluffals
description: (Once per Duel): You can discard 1 card; send 1 "Fluffal" card from your Deck to your GY, and if you do, you can add 1 "Toy Vendor" from your GY to your hand.

name: Herald of Fairness
description: Negate the first and second effects of "Herald of the Arc Light". This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Not So Quick
description: The effects of "Mudora the Sword Oracle" and "Keldo the Sacred Protector" are no longer Quick Effects. This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: You Can't Hide from Destiny
description: (Once per turn): If you activate "Clock Tower Prison" you can add 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your Deck to your hand. Each time a "Destiny HERO" monster is Summoned, place 1 Clock Counter on "Clock Tower Prison". If "Clock Tower Prison" has 4 or more Clock Counters during your turn, destroy it.

name: The Guard Guardian
description: While you control at least 2 "Celtic Guard" monsters, and no non-"Celtic Guard" monsters, negate the first effect of "Celtic Guard of Noble Arms".

name: Phantom Force
description: "Phantom Beast" monsters in your possession are also always treated as "Gladiator Beast" monsters, and "Gladiator Beast" monsters in your possession are also always treated as "Phantom Beast" monsters.

name: Tri-Heart Attack
description: Negate the first effect of "Scareclaw Tri-Heart". This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Crikey Mate
description: "Ayers Rock Sunrise" can also target Beast-Warrior monsters.

name: Dtryna Act Up
description: The third effect of "Dyna Tank" can only Special Summon Normal Monsters. Negate the first effect of Kaitoptera. This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: I Haven't Read Misc
description: Negate the first effect of "Miscellaneousaurus". This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Fragile Fossils
description: You can choose if "Paleozoic" monsters you control are destroyed by your card effects.

name: Blockdomination
description: "Block" monsters gain 500 ATK/DEF. Face-up "Block" monsters swap their original ATK and DEF.

name: Traps Got Me Rock Hard
description: If you excavate a Continuous Trap with an effect that Special Summons itself as a monster off Diggin' for Gems, you can add that card to your hand instead of Summoning/adding an EARTH/Rock monster.

name: Part of the Family
description: The effect of "Insect Invitation" instead makes your opponent's monsters also become Insect. This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Tiiiime is on my Siiiiide
description: The effect of "Time Wizard" is now thrice per turn. The effect to destroy all monsters your opponent controls now destroys 1 monster your opponent controls. This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Straight Sniping
description: (Once per turn): You can use the effect of "Snipe Hunter" without discarding once this turn.

name: Cup Full of Aces
description: (Once per Duel): If you Special Summon "Couple of Aces", you can add up to 3 "Cup of Ace" from your Deck, or GY to your hand.

name: Heavy Metal Morphers
description: While you control "Slot Machine", monsters you control are also treated as DARK Machine monsters.

name: Less Chaos
description: Negate the second effect of "Arcana Force EX - The Chaos Ruler". This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Watt Did You Say?!
description: Negate the first effect of "Wattkingdom". This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Batteryman C-hanging
description: The effect of "Batteryman C" also increases the ATK/DEF of "Batteryman" monsters.

name: Conversion Therapy
description: You can Xyz Summon "Lightning Chidori" using 2 Level 4 Thunder monsters instead. The effect of "Electrode Beast Cation" no longer prevents you from Special Summoning from the Extra Deck.

name: Just a Prank
description: Thunder monsters in your possession are always treated as "Prank-Kids" monsters.

name: Nemesis of the Nemeses
description: "Nemeses" monsters in your possession are always treated as Thunder monsters. Negate the second effect of "Archnemeses Protos". This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Royal Light
description: An opponent's monster you target with the effect of "The Monarchs Masterplan" is treated as a LIGHT monster.

name: Gadget Rush
description: You can Normal Summon "Gadget" monsters while you control "Boss Rush".

name: Never Forget
description: (Once per turn): You can tribute 1 "Gadget" monster you control, to Special Summon 1 "Mecha Phantom Beast Token" (Machine/WIND/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 0).

name: XYZ SHOUKAN!
description: You can Special Summon Fusion Monsters that list "X-Head Cannon", "Y-Dragon Head", and/or "Z-Metal Tank" as material, by also banishing cards from your GY.

name: Seafood Delight
description: Learn the "Seafood Platter" recipe (Check your sheet).

name: "Leftovers"
description: Learn the ""Leftovers"" recipe (Check your sheet).

name: Chip Shop Chewsday
description: Learn the “British “Person”” recipe (Check your sheet).

name: Herald of Fairness
description: Negate the first and second effects of "Herald of the Arc Light". This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Allen and Adrien’s Psychic Solar Psybeam
description: Once per turn, if you banish a card from your hand, you can pay 500LP and draw 1 card.

name: Absolutely Bonked
description: The first effect of “Absolute Axon Kicker” banishes 1 card on the field instead. This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Jammed Blaster
description: You can only use the second effect of "Psychic Blaster Mk-II" during your Main Phase. This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: End of the Beginning of the End
description: "Chaos End Ruler - Ruler of the Beginning and the End" can banish any 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster from your GY for its summoning condition instead. The effect of "Chaos End Ruler - Ruler of the Beginning and the End", only banishes 1 card from your opponent's field or GY instead. This Skill cannot leave your inventory.

name: Best Isles
description: You cannot target monsters in your opponent's GY with the effects of "Bystial" monsters. This Skill cannot leave your inventory.
